name: copilot-token-efficiency-optimizer
description: Analyze a repo and apply token-reduction levers for Copilot agent mode (exclusions, scoped instructions, lean tool sets, plan/implement agents, healthy indexing) for more accuracy at lower AI-credit cost.

commands.title: Token Optimizer: Optimize Prompt for Copilot
Token Optimizer: Undo Last Applied Changes
Token Optimizer: Setup Knowledge Graph (install once)
Token Optimizer: Index Repo Into Knowledge Graph
Token Optimizer: Open Knowledge Graph & Analysis
Token Optimizer: Configure Copilot to Use Knowledge Graph

tokenmin.features.knowledgeGraphContext.markdownDescription: Knowledge Graph Context: let Copilot agents query the local codebase knowledge graph (codebase-memory-mcp) before broad file reads. Drives whether `Configure Copilot to Use Knowledge Graph` writes the MCP server + graph agents.

tokenmin.features.queryCaching.markdownDescription: Knowledge Graph Query Caching: cache `search_graph` / `trace_path` results per repo + query so repeated agent queries are cheap. The cache is invalidated when indexing or `detect_changes` shows the graph changed.

tokenmin.features.promptRestructuring.markdownDescription: Prompt Restructuring: enable the `Optimize Prompt` workflow that rewrites vague prompts into focused intent, constraints, relevant files/symbols, acceptance criteria and verification steps before you paste them into Copilot Chat.

tokenmin.features.tokenTracking.markdownDescription: Token Comparison Tracking: show estimated token usage with and without TokenMin (graph vs file reads, original vs restructured prompt, cached vs fresh query). Estimates only — actual Copilot billing is not exposed to extensions.

tokenmin.features.graph3dVisualization.markdownDescription: 3D Knowledge Graph Visualization: enable the embedded VS Code webview that hosts the codebase-memory-mcp 3D graph UI (no external browser required).

tokenmin.exclusionAggressiveness.markdownDescription: How aggressively to recommend `search.exclude` / `files.exclude` globs. `conservative` excludes only well-known generated/dependency dirs; `aggressive` also excludes lockfiles, logs, and large data files.

tokenmin.modelFamilyPreference.markdownDescription: Preferred Copilot model family for the optional model-assisted tailoring pass (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4.1`, `o1`). Falls back to any available model if the preferred family is unavailable.

tokenmin.applyToNewBranch.markdownDescription: When applying changes, offer to first create and switch to a new git branch so changes are isolated.

tokenmin.maxFilesScanned.markdownDescription: Safety cap on the number of files walked during analysis. Large repos are bounded to keep analysis fast.

tokenmin.knowledgeGraph.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Advanced: absolute path to a manually installed `codebase-memory-mcp` binary. Leave empty to let TokenMin install and manage a single copy in extension global storage (installed once, reused for every repository).

tokenmin.knowledgeGraph.uiPort.markdownDescription: Port to use when opening the optional codebase-memory-mcp 3D graph UI.
